title: dcmdjpeg.fs
description: A tool to decode JPEG-compressed DICOM files.

input_file.description: DICOM input filename to be converted
input_file.title: Input File

help.description: Print this help text and exit
help.title: Help Flag

quiet.description: Quiet mode, print no warnings and errors
quiet.title: Quiet Flag

log_level.description: Use level l for the logger (fatal, error, warn, info, debug, trace)
log_level.title: Log Level

log_config.description: Use config file f for the logger
log_config.title: Log Config

read_file.description: Read file format or data set (default)
read_file.title: Read File Flag

read_dataset.description: Read data set without file meta information
read_dataset.title: Read Dataset Flag

conv_lossy.description: Convert YCbCr to RGB if lossy JPEG
conv_lossy.title: Conv Lossy Flag

conv_guess.description: Convert to RGB if YCbCr is guessed by library
conv_guess.title: Conv Guess Flag

conv_guess_lossy.description: Convert to RGB if lossy JPEG and YCbCr is guessed
conv_guess_lossy.title: Conv Guess Lossy Flag

planar_auto.description: Automatically determine planar configuration from SOP class and color space (default)
planar_auto.title: Planar Auto Flag

workaround_pred6.description: Enable workaround for JPEG lossless images with overflow in predictor 6
workaround_pred6.title: Workaround Pred6 Flag

workaround_incpl.description: Enable workaround for incomplete JPEG data
workaround_incpl.title: Workaround Incomplete JPEG Data Flag

write_dataset.description: Write data set without file meta information
write_dataset.title: Write Dataset Flag

write_xfer_little.description: Write with explicit VR little endian (default)
write_xfer_little.title: Write Xfer Little Flag

write_xfer_big.description: Write with explicit VR big endian TS
write_xfer_big.title: Write Xfer Big Flag

write_xfer_implicit.description: Write with implicit VR little endian TS
write_xfer_implicit.title: Write Xfer Implicit Flag

disable_new_vr.description: Disable support for new VRs, convert to OB
disable_new_vr.title: Disable New VR Flag

group_length_create.description: Always write with group length elements
group_length_create.title: Group Length Create Flag

group_length_remove.description: Always write without group length elements
group_length_remove.title: Group Length Remove Flag

padding_retain.description: Do not change padding (default if not --write-dataset)
padding_retain.title: Padding Retain Flag

padding_create.description: Align file on multiple of f bytes and items on multiple of i bytes
padding_create.title: Padding Create
